title: Ryan Hoover - Founder of Product Hunt - CMX Summit 2014
description:
Ryan Hoover is the Founder of Product Hunt, a community of early adopters sharing and geeking out about the best new products, every day.  Prior to Product Hunt, he was the Director of Product at PlayHaven (now Upsight) and EIR at Tradecraft.  He is also the contributing writer of Hooked: How to Build Habit Forming Products, and writes about startup trends, product design, and growth on his blog at ryanhoover.me.
